title: Frontend Engineer (React / TypeScript)
job_description:
We are seeking a Frontend Engineer passionate about crafting pixel-perfect, accessible, and ultra-fast web user interfaces. You will translate Figma mockups into reusable component architectures and integrate with RESTful and GraphQL endpoints.

Key Responsibilities:
- Build reactive, modular client-side components using React, TypeScript, and modern CSS/Tailwind.
- Manage complex client state using Redux Toolkit, Context API, or React Query.
- Optimize web vitals (LCP, FID, CLS) for maximum speed, responsiveness, and cross-browser fidelity.
- Write unit tests for UI components using Jest / React Testing Library.
- Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers in Figma and backend engineers.

Minimum Qualifications:
- Strong foundation in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Hands-on project experience with React, Next.js, and modern styling libraries (Tailwind CSS).
- Solid grasp of asynchronous JavaScript (Promises, async/await), DOM manipulation, and REST APIs.
- Familiarity with Git workflows and modern build tools (Vite, Webpack).
min_education: B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / MCA in CS / IT
